business-hours.title: Business Hours
business-hours.description: Seven-day hours schedule with site timezone, closed-day support, strict clock validation and optional highlight of current weekday.

calendar.title: Events Calendar
calendar.description: Timezone-aware curated events with strict date validation, upcoming list or accessible monthly grid, and optional safe event links.

chart.title: Chart / Graph
chart.description: Server-rendered accessible horizontal bars, columns and donut using numeric data and palette tokens.

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.description: Timezone-aware countdown to a fixed date, accessible units, completion message and no-JS target-date fallback.

flip.title: Flip / Hover Box
flip.description: Two-sided native disclosure card with reduced-motion CSS, keyboard/touch support and optional CTA.

forms.title: Form
forms.description: Embed a published WPForms Lite or Contact Form 7 form by ID, leaving validation, submissions and spam prevention to the form plugin.

image-carousel.title: Image Carousel
image-carousel.description: Scroll-snap carousel with WordPress responsive images, arrows/dots, reduced-motion-aware opt-in autoplay, and usable no-JS horizontal scroll.

image-comparison.title: Image Comparison
image-comparison.description: Before/after image reveal with accessible keyboard range slider and static no-JS 50/50 comparison.

map.title: Privacy-first Map
map.description: Validated coordinates, link to OpenStreetMap, and optional click-to-load interactive map without third-party requests until consent.

modal.title: Modal / Popup
modal.description: Explicit-click, accessible native dialog with backdrop/Escape close and an independently usable no-JS disclosure.

posts-grid.title: Posts Grid
posts-grid.description: Dynamic posts, pages and public custom post types in a responsive grid with term filters, metadata and accessible pagination.

price-list.title: Price List / Restaurant Menu
price-list.description: Accessible repeatable product, service or restaurant price list with image, descriptions, old prices, badges, safe links and responsive layouts.

pricing-table.title: Pricing Table
pricing-table.description: Accessible standalone plan card with included/excluded features, honest price display, optional badge and safe CTA.

products.title: WooCommerce Products
products.description: Dependency-safe WooCommerce product grid with featured/category/ID query, published products, pricing, ratings and safe product-page links.

social-feed.title: Social Feed
social-feed.description: Curated social posts or live native WordPress post cards; no unapproved third-party scraping or background API calls.

timeline.title: Timeline / Steps
timeline.description: Semantic timeline of milestones with safe rich descriptions, media attachments, optional details links and responsive layouts.

tooltip.title: Interactive / Tooltip
tooltip.description: Accessible tooltip, native show-more disclosure and keyboard-operated two-panel content switcher. No-JavaScript fallbacks and responsive controls.
